subject: CLAIM api-surface-sonnet (overnight 10-27): events/fences + API completeness; exact regions in compute_frontend.m, blit_encoder.inc
body:
Task (user, until 07:00): make the Metal frontend API surface complete for real iOS 16.5 clients; implement, not audit. Inventory tooling: gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/api_inventory.py (iPhoneOS16.5 SDK headers vs frontend selectors); ledger gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/API-SURFACE.md. I own NEW files: gpu/metal/tegu/api_events.inc, api_surface.inc (+ api_surface_host_test) and tests/api_surface_frontend_test.py. Prefer-new-files policy; the ONLY edits to shared files are the following exact regions (no heavy builds before I post HEAVY TAKE; jobs1, nice 10):
compute_frontend.m (1) struct Dispatch: add 3 fields (eventKind, eventValue, eventObject) right after 'unsigned perfPass;' (l.553). (2) TeguCommand -encodeSignalEvent:value: body (l.1587-1592, currently refuses + invalidates) -> calls tegu_command_encode_event() defined in api_events.inc. (3) teguExecute job loop: the async-reap condition line 'if(async&&(j->blit||j->expandOut||j->genericPreclear)&&' gets '||j->eventKind', and one new block 'if(j->eventKind){...;continue;}' immediately before 'if(j->blit) {' (event wait/signal are pseudo-jobs: every reorder/batch/shadow pass treats them as barriers because genericDrawSnapshot=0). I do NOT touch commitAndWaitUntilSubmitted, the early-scheduled/throttle code, tail/finish, or any perf accounting. (4) TeguCommand -dealloc: one release line for eventObject. (5) one '#include \"api_events.inc\"' / '#include \"api_surface.inc\"' after the TeguEncoder TextureBindings block (before the blit_encoder.inc include).
blit_encoder.inc: -updateFence:/-waitForFence: bodies only (validate TeguFence of the same device; today they accept nil-less garbage).
render_encoder.inc / render_pipeline.inc / compositor_submit.inc / air_bridge.rs: NOT touched now; I will post a separate exact-region CLAIM before any render-encoder setter work (setViewports:count:, store-action setters, useResources, updateFence/waitForFence, textureBarrier, state-honesty for setBlendColor/setDepthBias/setStencil*).
Reading: encodeSignalEvent today = TEGU_INVALID (command fails) - any client using MTLEvent/MTLSharedEvent/fences currently gets failed command buffers or an unrecognized selector (-newFence/-newEvent/-newSharedEvent do not exist on the device).
